actions.title: Local IP addresses
actions.command: (Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^(127\.|169\.254\.)' } | Sort-Object InterfaceIndex).IPAddress
actions.description: Copies this PC's IPv4 addresses, one per line, to the clipboard.

actions.title: Branch name
actions.description: Copies the current git branch of this folder to the clipboard.

actions.title: Tree (ASCII)
actions.description: Copies this folder as a tree with box-drawing lines. Folders end with a slash.

actions.title: Tree (plain ASCII)
actions.description: Copies this folder as a tree drawn with plain + - | characters for apps that mangle Unicode.

actions.title: Tree, folders only
actions.description: Copies the folder structure without any files.

actions.title: Tree to depth...
actions.description: Copies this folder as a tree but only down to the level you choose.

actions.title: Tree with sizes
actions.description: Copies this folder as a tree with a size next to every item. A folder shows the total of everything inside it.

actions.title: Tree as Markdown
actions.description: Copies this folder as a tree inside a Markdown code fence.

actions.title: Tree as nested list
actions.description: Copies this folder as an indented bullet list you can paste into Notion or Obsidian.

actions.title: Tree (respect .gitignore)
actions.description: Copies this folder as a tree but leaves out everything git ignores. Without git it skips common build folders instead.

actions.title: Tree as JSON
actions.description: Copies this folder as JSON: name, type, size and children for every item.

actions.title: All subfolder names
actions.description: Copies the names of the folders directly inside this one.

actions.title: All subfolder names (recursive)
actions.description: Copies every different folder name found below this folder, sorted.

actions.title: All subfolder paths (relative)
actions.description: Copies the path of every folder below this one, relative to it.

actions.title: All file names (recursive)
actions.description: Copies the name of every file below this folder.

actions.title: All file paths (relative)
actions.description: Copies the path of every file below this folder, relative to it. Common build folders are skipped.

actions.title: All file paths (absolute)
actions.description: Copies the full path of every file below this folder.

actions.title: File paths of type...
actions.description: Copies the relative path of every file with the extension you choose.

actions.title: Listing as CSV
actions.description: Copies every file and folder below this one as CSV: path, name, extension, size, modified.

actions.title: Listing as JSON
actions.description: Copies every file and folder below this one as a JSON array.

actions.title: File types summary
actions.description: Copies how many files of each type are below this folder and how big they are, biggest first.

actions.title: Count files and folders
actions.description: Shows how many files and folders are below this folder and their total size. The text is also copied.

actions.title: Path
actions.command: @({paths}) -join "`n"
actions.description: Copies the full path, one per line when several items are selected.

actions.title: Path escaped (\\)
actions.command: (@({paths}) | ForEach-Object { $_.Replace('\', '\\') }) -join "`n"
actions.description: Copies the path with every backslash doubled, ready to paste into a JSON or code string.

actions.title: Path as PowerShell literal
actions.command: (@({paths}) | ForEach-Object { "'" + $_.Replace("'", "''") + "'" }) -join "`n"
actions.description: Copies the path as a single-quoted PowerShell string that survives apostrophes.

actions.title: 8.3 short path
actions.command:
$fso = New-Object -ComObject Scripting.FileSystemObject
(@({paths}) | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ -PathType Container) { $fso.GetFolder($_).ShortPath } else { $fso.GetFile($_).ShortPath } }) -join "`n"
actions.description: Copies the old DOS-style short path (needs 8.3 names to be enabled on the drive).

actions.title: Path relative to repo root
actions.description: Copies the path relative to the root of the git repository it is in, with forward slashes.

actions.title: Path relative to marked folder
actions.description: Copies the path relative to the folder you marked with Mark for compare.

actions.title: Copy folder for AI
actions.description: Copies this folder as one block of text for an AI chat: a tree, then every text file under a heading with a code block. Binary, huge and lock files are skipped.

actions.title: Copy selected files for AI
actions.description: Copies the selected files as one block of text for an AI chat, each under a heading with a code block.

actions.title: Contents as code block
actions.description: Copies the text of the file inside a Markdown code block that has the right language tag.

actions.title: Permalink to this file
actions.description: Copies a link to this file as it is in the current commit, for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps.

actions.title: Last commit (hash + message)
actions.description: Copies the short hash and message of the last commit. For a file it is the last commit that touched that file.

actions.title: Remote URL
actions.description: Copies the address of the remote this repository pushes to.

actions.title: Open repo in browser
actions.description: Opens this repository's page in your browser. For a file it opens that file's page.

actions.title: Fetch all repos below
actions.description: Runs git fetch in every repository below this folder and lists what happened. Nothing in your files changes.

actions.title: History of this file
actions.command:
$p = {path}
& git -C (Split-Path -Parent $p) log --follow --oneline -n 50 -- $p
actions.description: Shows the last 50 commits that changed this file, following renames.

actions.title: Who changed this file?
actions.description: Shows who wrote how many lines of this file, from git blame.

actions.title: Find text in files...
actions.description: Searches the text inside every file below this folder and lists each matching line.

actions.title: Empty folders
actions.description: Lists folders that have nothing inside them.

actions.title: Files changed between...
actions.description: Lists files that were changed between two dates you choose.

actions.title: Terminal here
actions.command:
$d = {path}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Leaf) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d }
if (Get-Command wt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process wt -ArgumentList '-d', ('"' + $d.TrimEnd('\') + '"') } else { Start-Process powershell -WorkingDirectory $d -ArgumentList '-NoExit' }
actions.description: Opens Windows Terminal in this folder, or PowerShell if Windows Terminal is not installed.

actions.title: PowerShell 7 here
actions.command:
$d = {path}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Leaf) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d }
Start-Process pwsh -WorkingDirectory $d -ArgumentList '-NoExit'
actions.description: Opens PowerShell 7 in this folder.

actions.title: Admin terminal here
actions.command:
$d = {path}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Leaf) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d }
if (Get-Command wt -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process wt -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList '-d', ('"' + $d.TrimEnd('\') + '"') } else { Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', ('Set-Location -LiteralPath ''' + $d.Replace("'", "''") + '''') }
actions.description: Opens a terminal in this folder with administrator rights. Windows asks you to confirm.

actions.title: Git Bash here
actions.description: Opens Git Bash in this folder.

actions.title: Run console here
actions.command:
$d = {path}; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d -PathType Leaf) { $d = Split-Path -Parent $d }
Start-Process -FilePath $env:PSTOOLS_EXE -ArgumentList 'run', ('"' + $d.TrimEnd('\') + '"')
actions.description: Opens the Run console with this folder as the working folder.

actions.title: Edit with...
actions.command: Start-Process rundll32.exe -ArgumentList 'shell32.dll,OpenAs_RunDLL', ('"' + {path} + '"')
actions.description: Opens the Windows Open with dialog for this file.

actions.title: File facts
actions.description: Shows the encoding, line endings, line count, size, dates and SHA-256 of this file, plus the signature or image size where it applies.

actions.title: Where did this come from?
actions.description: Shows where a downloaded file came from, using the mark Windows put on it.

actions.title: Is this folder on PATH?
actions.description: Tells you whether this folder is on your PATH, so its programs can be run by name.

actions.title: Who is locking this?
actions.description: Lists the programs that currently have this file, or any file inside this folder, open.

actions.title: Compare the two selected
actions.description: Compares the two items you selected: for folders it lists files only on one side or different, for files it lists the lines that differ.

actions.title: Are these identical?
actions.description: Checks whether the selected files have exactly the same content.

actions.title: Zip (respect .gitignore)
actions.description: Zips this folder next to it, leaving out everything git ignores.

actions.title: Extract (tar/7z/gz)
actions.description: Extracts a tar, tgz, gz, 7z or rar archive into a folder next to it.

actions.title: List archive contents
actions.description: Lists the files inside a zip, tar, gz, 7z or rar archive without extracting it.

actions.title: Copy dimensions
actions.description: Copies the width and height of the selected pictures, for example 1200x800.

actions.title: Convert to WebP
actions.description: Converts the picture to WebP using ImageMagick or ffmpeg, whichever you have.

actions.title: Extract audio (MP3)
actions.command: $p = {path}; $o = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($p, '.mp3'); & ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i $p -vn -q:a 2 $o; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'ffmpeg failed.' } else { 'Created ' + (Split-Path -Leaf $o) }
actions.description: Saves the sound of the video as an MP3 file next to it.

actions.title: Compress video (H.264, CRF 28)
actions.command: $p = {path}; $o = [IO.Path]::Combine((Split-Path -Parent $p), [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($p) + '-compressed.mp4'); & ffmpeg -y -i $p -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset medium -c:a aac $o 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { 'Created ' + (Split-Path -Leaf $o) }
actions.description: Makes a smaller copy of the video with H.264 and shows ffmpeg's progress.

actions.title: Video to GIF (first 10 s)
actions.command: $p = {path}; $o = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($p, '.gif'); & ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -t 10 -i $p -vf 'fps=12,scale=640:-1:flags=lanczos' $o; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'ffmpeg failed.' } else { 'Created ' + (Split-Path -Leaf $o) }
actions.description: Makes an animated GIF from the first 10 seconds of the video.

actions.title: npm install here
actions.command:
Set-Location -LiteralPath {dir}
npm install 2>&1
actions.description: Runs npm install in this folder and shows the output.

actions.title: Create Python venv here
actions.description: Creates a Python virtual environment named .venv here, and installs requirements.txt when there is one.

actions.title: Free port...
actions.description: Stops the program that is listening on a port, so you can use the port again.

actions.title: Add this folder to user PATH
actions.command:
$d = ({path}).TrimEnd('\')
$key = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentUser.OpenSubKey('Environment', $true)
$old = [string]$key.GetValue('Path', '', [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueOptions]::DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames)
$parts = @($old -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
$present = @($parts | Where-Object { $_.TrimEnd('\').Equals($d, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0
if ($present) { 'Already on your PATH.'; return }
$new = (($parts + $d) -join ';')
$dataDir = if ($env:PSTOOLS_DATA) { $env:PSTOOLS_DATA } else { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'PSTools' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dataDir | Out-Null
Add-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dataDir 'changes.txt') -Value ('{0}|PATH|{1}' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $old) -Encoding UTF8
$key.SetValue('Path', $new, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::ExpandString)
$key.Close()
Add-Type -Namespace PstEnv -Name Native -MemberDefinition '[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError=true, CharSet=System.Runtime.InteropServices.CharSet.Auto)] public static extern System.IntPtr SendMessageTimeout(System.IntPtr hWnd, uint Msg, System.UIntPtr wParam, string lParam, uint fuFlags, uint uTimeout, out System.UIntPtr lpdwResult);'
$r = [UIntPtr]::Zero
[void][PstEnv.Native]::SendMessageTimeout([IntPtr]0xffff, 0x1A, [UIntPtr]::Zero, 'Environment', 2, 5000, [ref]$r)
'Added to your user PATH. Open a new terminal to use it.'
actions.description: Adds this folder to your user PATH. The old value is saved so it can be put back.

actions.title: Remove folder from user PATH
actions.command:
$d = ({path}).TrimEnd('\')
$key = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentUser.OpenSubKey('Environment', $true)
$old = [string]$key.GetValue('Path', '', [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueOptions]::DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames)
$parts = @($old -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
$present = @($parts | Where-Object { $_.TrimEnd('\').Equals($d, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }).Count -gt 0
if (-not $present) { 'This folder is not on your user PATH.'; return }
$new = (($parts | Where-Object { -not $_.TrimEnd('\').Equals($d, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) }) -join ';')
$dataDir = if ($env:PSTOOLS_DATA) { $env:PSTOOLS_DATA } else { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'PSTools' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dataDir | Out-Null
Add-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dataDir 'changes.txt') -Value ('{0}|PATH|{1}' -f (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), $old) -Encoding UTF8
$key.SetValue('Path', $new, [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::ExpandString)
$key.Close()
Add-Type -Namespace PstEnv -Name Native -MemberDefinition '[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError=true, CharSet=System.Runtime.InteropServices.CharSet.Auto)] public static extern System.IntPtr SendMessageTimeout(System.IntPtr hWnd, uint Msg, System.UIntPtr wParam, string lParam, uint fuFlags, uint uTimeout, out System.UIntPtr lpdwResult);'
$r = [UIntPtr]::Zero
[void][PstEnv.Native]::SendMessageTimeout([IntPtr]0xffff, 0x1A, [UIntPtr]::Zero, 'Environment', 2, 5000, [ref]$r)
'Removed from your user PATH. Open a new terminal to see it.'
actions.description: Removes this folder from your user PATH. The old value is saved so it can be put back.

actions.title: Public IP address
actions.command:
try { $ip = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.ipify.org' -TimeoutSec 5).ToString().Trim(); $ip }
catch { '##PST-TOAST## Could not reach the internet to look up your public IP address.' }
actions.description: Copies the IP address the internet sees for this PC. It asks api.ipify.org, so it needs a connection.

actions.title: Uptime
actions.command:
$boot = (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
$span = (Get-Date) - $boot
'Up {0} day{1} {2} h {3} min (since {4})' -f [int]$span.TotalDays, $(if ([int]$span.TotalDays -eq 1) { '' } else { 's' }), $span.Hours, $span.Minutes, $boot.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')
actions.description: Shows how long this PC has been running since the last start.
